title: DebateSpeak PA3 use-case catalogue
status: Prepared for human review; no implementation or Jira completion is implied.

scope_notes.PA3: Implemented in PA3. FG-01 (all eight account use cases) is the Part E slice, with refresh sessions, profile, deletion and admin suspension. Recovery screens stay switched off until real email delivery is verified.
scope_notes.PA4: Planned for PA4. FG-03 room screens exist in PA3 only as previews with sample data; no room API exists yet.
scope_notes.future-mvp: MVP behaviour planned for later builds, except FG-03 session controls whose PA3 media boundary must remain explicit.
scope_notes.should: Conditional enhancement; cut before Must requirements if schedule slips.
scope_notes.stretch: Could requirement, not a PA3 implementation commitment.
scope_notes.post-mvp: Explicitly deferred FR-57..60; contracts are design-only and may not enable production UI.

actors.name: Authenticated user
actors.description: Shared authenticated identity; general actor only, not a permission to access every role.

actors.name: Visitor
actors.description: Registers, signs in, or requests password recovery.

actors.name: Learner / Debater
actors.description: Practises with a partner and controls own learning data.

actors.name: Moderator / Admin
actors.description: Performs authorized moderation and operational tasks.

actors.name: Human evaluator
actors.description: Grades only assigned, ended debates under dual sharing consent.

actors.name: Teacher
actors.description: Reads explicitly shared student dashboards; no class-management workflows are designed.

actors.name: Audience member
actors.description: Receives only authorized room media; never publishes or grades.

actors.name: LLM provider
actors.description: Returns schema-validated analysis through LLMAdapter; not the authorizing actor.

use_cases.title: Register account
use_cases.goal: Create an account without granting media or AI-processing consent.

use_cases.title: Sign in
use_cases.goal: Authenticate and recover an authorized application session.

use_cases.title: Maintain learner profile
use_cases.goal: Maintain display name, native language, self-assessed CEFR and goals.

use_cases.title: Sign out
use_cases.goal: End the current session without keeping the account active in this browser.

use_cases.title: Recover forgotten password
use_cases.goal: Regain account access through a verified password-reset process.

use_cases.title: Review active sessions
use_cases.goal: Inspect own authenticated sessions without exposing session credentials.

use_cases.title: Delete own account and data
use_cases.goal: Immediately disable the account and erase associated learning data within seven days.

use_cases.title: Suspend or reactivate account
use_cases.goal: Restrict or restore account access using authorized moderation.

use_cases.title: Browse and select topics
use_cases.goal: Find a curated topic by category, text and CEFR before creating a room.

use_cases.title: Manage topic library
use_cases.goal: Create, edit, tag and retire public topics without corrupting existing debate history.

use_cases.title: Get personalized topic recommendations
use_cases.goal: Find topics appropriate to self-assessed CEFR and observed practice needs.

use_cases.title: Propose a custom topic
use_cases.goal: Submit a topic for moderation before it becomes publicly available.

use_cases.title: Create debate room
use_cases.goal: Create a two-person LOBBY with a topic, stance mode, format, duration and invite.

use_cases.title: Join invited room
use_cases.goal: Join by code or link while the server enforces two distinct debaters and room availability.

use_cases.title: View lobby and readiness
use_cases.goal: See authoritative room state and participant presence without treating presence as consent.

use_cases.title: Give or withdraw processing consent
use_cases.goal: Control own informed consent for transcription and AI processing without coercion.

use_cases.title: Start debate
use_cases.goal: Enter LIVE only after server-side dual consent, mic readiness and actual media availability.

use_cases.title: Leave or end debate
use_cases.goal: Leave safely before LIVE or stop a live debate and all capture promptly.

use_cases.title: Follow debate and turn timers
use_cases.goal: See authoritative session and turn timing without enforcing silence through AI.

use_cases.title: Report abusive behavior
use_cases.goal: Submit a room or transcript abuse report while retaining accessible leave/end controls.

use_cases.title: Review abuse and close room
use_cases.goal: Review submitted reports and apply authorized room closure with an audit record.

use_cases.title: Use private room text chat
use_cases.goal: Exchange room chat only when enabled; keep it separate from transcript and AI inputs by default.

use_cases.title: Practise solo with an AI opponent
use_cases.goal: Practise with generated opponent turns after a separate TTS contract and personal capture-consent design.

use_cases.title: Authorize and join audience access
use_cases.goal: Admit capped, non-publishing audience access only with both debaters' consent.

use_cases.title: Validate start readiness
use_cases.goal: As a mandatory start subcase, reject stale or missing membership, consent, mic, expiry or media-capability gates.

use_cases.title: Select and test microphone
use_cases.goal: Choose an input and explicitly run a local mic test with permission-recovery guidance.

use_cases.title: Exchange audio and control mute
use_cases.goal: Speak on independent tracks, hear the partner and control own mute after dual consent.

use_cases.title: Recover a dropped connection
use_cases.goal: Rejoin the existing identity within a visible 60-second grace period or finish the session.

use_cases.title: Enable optional live video
use_cases.goal: Add video only through a separately consented optional flow that preserves audio priority.

use_cases.title: View speaker-attributed live transcript
use_cases.goal: Read partial and finalized timestamped transcript text linked deterministically to each speaker's track.

use_cases.title: Review and export full transcript
use_cases.goal: Review an authorized finished transcript and download text or Markdown.

use_cases.title: Use mixed-audio diarization fallback
use_cases.goal: Recover speaker-attributed text for an explicitly supported mixed-audio input without replacing track attribution by default.

use_cases.title: Review language corrections
use_cases.goal: Receive CEFR-appropriate grammar and vocabulary feedback quoting the learner's exact transcript.

use_cases.title: Review speaking metrics
use_cases.goal: Inspect deterministic pace, fillers, pauses, talk-time and lexical metrics with measurement limits.

use_cases.title: Review recurring language patterns
use_cases.goal: Inspect evidenced recurring errors within and across own debates.

use_cases.title: Review pronunciation assessment
use_cases.goal: Receive separately authorized pronunciation assessment without equating accent with reasoning quality.

use_cases.title: Validate cited transcript evidence
use_cases.goal: As a mandatory feedback subcase, reject missing, empty, non-verbatim, cross-speaker or cross-segment citations.

use_cases.title: Review argument structure and rebuttals
use_cases.goal: Inspect claims, reasons, rebuttals, relevance and evidence quality using attributable transcript context.

use_cases.title: Review potential logical fallacies
use_cases.goal: Inspect a potential fallacy with exact evidence, context, explanation and a specific repair.

use_cases.title: Inspect claim verdicts and evidence
use_cases.goal: Inspect bounded fact checks, five-way verdicts, source snippets, uncertainty and evaluator disagreement.

use_cases.title: Show optional live fact-check overlay
use_cases.goal: Opt into bounded live evidence overlays without delaying audio or presenting uncertain claims as settled.

use_cases.title: Review debate evaluation and consensus
use_cases.goal: Inspect a versioned rubric, deterministic consensus and contested flags with an honest single-judge baseline.

use_cases.title: Configure analysis and inspect usage
use_cases.goal: Manage provider/model, prompt versions, flags and budgets without exposing secrets to the client.

use_cases.title: Run optional heterogeneous judge panel
use_cases.goal: Enable three or more different judge models only under reviewed budget and consensus rules.

use_cases.title: Assign a human evaluator
use_cases.goal: Assign a reviewer to an ended debate only after both debaters authorize transcript and grade sharing.

use_cases.title: Submit human grading card
use_cases.goal: Score only an assigned ended debate using the versioned shared rubric while preserving AI grades separately.

use_cases.title: View shared human grades
use_cases.goal: See submitted human and AI evaluations side by side only while dual sharing authorization permits access.

use_cases.title: Review personalized learning report
use_cases.goal: Review a post-debate summary, evidenced feedback and a concrete practice plan without fabricated completeness.

use_cases.title: Browse own debate history
use_cases.goal: Find past authorized debates and open their transcript and report.

use_cases.title: Review longitudinal progress
use_cases.goal: Compare observed metrics and recurring patterns while exposing missing data and non-certified proficiency limits.

use_cases.title: Track analysis status and retry
use_cases.goal: Inspect queued/running/failed stages and request a bounded retry while keeping partial results clearly labelled.

use_cases.title: Export report PDF
use_cases.goal: Download an authorized report without silently including other learners' private details.

use_cases.title: Process deletion and retention requests
use_cases.goal: Apply authorized erasure and retention policies across transcripts, analyses, reports and optional chat.

use_cases.title: View consented student dashboards
use_cases.goal: Give read-only access only for students who already joined a class and explicitly shared; revoke access at any time. Class creation, rosters and assignments remain undesigned.

relationships.condition: Every start request executes authoritative gate validation.
Every retained language feedback item must pass citation validation.
Every retained argument critique must pass citation validation.
Every retained potential-fallacy critique must pass citation validation.
At topic discovery, when the learner requests personalized recommendations.
At media setup, when optional video is enabled and separately authorized.
During LIVE audio, when the learner opts into supported live evidence overlays.
At the evaluation view, when a human grade is submitted and both debaters still authorize sharing.
At report review, when the learner requests a supported PDF export.
